Video Editor Anup 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches easy, AI-powered video editing via chat.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Handles editing requests: trim, add background music, export polished results in 1–2 minutes.
- Runs fully in the cloud (no software install); keeps sessions for iterative edits.
- Includes clear error handling, session, and API token management.
